mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have partly cloudy skies at Fireman Park under a waning crescent moon with an elevated AQI of 51, and we expect an overnight low of 66 degrees with no rain predicted.
The city is managing regular engineering updates through AECOM Incorporated, and the Rec Department is currently hiring seasonal staff for various roles, including adult fitness instructors.
Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, or head to the ice arena for the Girls Try Hockey event; tomorrow, you can catch a yoga class at Insight Wellness.
Regarding the weekly report, on Thursday, July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a driver being arrested for O W I and cited for suspended registration.
You can still enjoy today's flavor, Snickers Swirl, but you will need to move quickly as the store closes in less than an hour; tomorrow's flavor is Georgia Peach.
